## User problem

What problem would this solve? Who is affected?

## Proposed behaviour

Describe the smallest useful version of the change.

## Local-first and honesty impact

- Does this require new network access?
- What happens when the data source is unavailable?
- How should the UI report coverage or uncertainty?

## Alternatives considered

Any simpler options or workarounds.

## Additional context

Mockups, links, or examples are welcome. Use synthetic data only.
